closed_findings: MAIN14-DIAGNOSTIC01: initial parser falsely required exact parameter values on the fatal line. Corrected parser requires the exact value display before the exact DUT fatal. No change to reference/stimuli/vector bytes/testbench/RTL; original failed run retained.
review_reasoning: A shared fresh rise_mask111 establishes all lanes at one actual sampled start; first falls and one actual common end determine raw counts. Proper-subset rises invalidate the whole partial, preventing later mixed-frame acceptance.

All count and witness increments are unsigned and guarded before MAX+1. Witness exhaustion takes priority over period/incoherence, disarms without wrap, and requires explicit rearm. This is structural reasoning, not full32/64 traversal.
Each newly started partial resets all valid fall data. Invalid partial fields are logically discarded by partial_valid; private stale storage is not used until a new common start overwrites it.
Old queued data retires independently of armed and may be replaced only by a new candidate on an empty or retiring slot; stall preserves the complete old payload. out_valid grants transport only.
reset/STOP/rearm suppress old handshakes and clear window/queue/diagnostics. Opaque tag latches only at rearm; a high baseline is not an observed rising start.
Nested priority emits at most one fault notification per edge; sticky flags and a saturating counter do not fabricate physical lost-frame counts.
